type_legend.A: Script span match. Deterministic. The required wording must appear in the transcript. No LLM is used, so Type A has no hallucination surface.
type_legend.B: Extract the SPOKEN value from the transcript (LLM), then compare it to the CRM/plan reference with deterministic code. The LLM is never shown the reference value.
type_legend.C: Observation only. Recorded as a note for coaching. blocks_sale is always false and can never be made true, including by override.

checks.name: Recording disclaimer given and consented
checks.regulatory_basis: Surveillance Devices Act / Retailer 1 call-recording policy

script_or_rule.description: Agent must disclose the call is recorded, state the purpose, and seek consent before proceeding.

checks.name: Account holder identity and authority confirmed
checks.regulatory_basis: NECF Rule 47 - explicit informed consent must come from an authorised person

script_or_rule.description: Agent must confirm they are speaking with the named account holder and that the person is authorised to make changes.
required_phrases: authorised to make changes to this account

checks.name: DMO / reference price statement read verbatim
checks.regulatory_basis: AER Retail Pricing Information Guidelines - Default Market Offer comparison

script_or_rule.description: The AER reference price statement must be read substantially verbatim. Paraphrasing the estimate disclaimer is a fail.
required_phrases: your actual cost will depend on your usage

checks.name: Peak usage rate stated matches the sold plan
checks.regulatory_basis: NECF Rule 46 - price disclosure before consent

script_or_rule.description: The agent must state the peak usage rate in cents per kilowatt hour. The spoken figure must match the plan actually being sold.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The peak electricity usage rate, in cents per kilowatt hour, that the AGENT stated to the customer on this call.

checks.name: Customer email captured correctly
checks.regulatory_basis: NECF Rule 60 - welcome pack and cooling-off notice must reach the customer

script_or_rule.description: The email the CUSTOMER gave on the call must match the email recorded in the CRM. A keying error here means the contract never reaches the customer.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The customer's own email address as spoken on the call. Spoken forms such as "j dot smith at gmail dot com" must be assembled into a normal address.

checks.name: NMI read back and confirmed
checks.regulatory_basis: Retailer 1 transfer-accuracy standard (non-blocking)

script_or_rule.description: Non-blocking extra. Agent should read back the National Meter Identifier and have it confirmed.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The NMI (National Meter Identifier) digits spoken on the call, usually 10 or 11 digits read out one at a time.

checks.name: Fuel type confirmed
checks.regulatory_basis: Retailer 1 transfer-accuracy standard (non-blocking)

script_or_rule.description: Non-blocking extra. Confirm whether the sale is electricity, gas, or dual fuel.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The fuel type being signed up on this call: electricity, gas, or dual fuel.

checks.name: Dead air on the call
checks.regulatory_basis: Coaching only - no regulatory basis, never blocks a sale

script_or_rule.description: Note any silence longer than 15 seconds so a team leader can coach hold etiquette. Silence is never treated as evidence of non-compliance.

checks.name: Talk-over and interruptions
checks.regulatory_basis: Coaching only - no regulatory basis, never blocks a sale

script_or_rule.description: Count turns that begin before the previous speaker finished. High counts usually mean poor audio separation, not a compliance breach.

type_legend.A: Script span match or a deterministic rule. No LLM. Placeholder tags such as [EMAIL] count as the value having been said.
type_legend.B: Extract what the AGENT asserted (LLM, or the deterministic fallback), then compare it to the lead and plan with deterministic code. Where the agent's words and the order screen disagree, G8 scores it as a reduced-confidence FAIL and the critical floor decides FAIL or UNSURE.
type_legend.C: Observation only. Coaching note. Never blocks a sale.

checks.name: Recording disclaimer given at the open
checks.regulatory_basis: Surveillance devices legislation / call-recording notice before the sales conversation

script_or_rule.description: Agent must say the call is recorded and why, within the first three agent turns, before any price is quoted.

checks.name: Customer identity verified (name as per ID, email, date of birth)
checks.regulatory_basis: Telecommunications Consumer Protections Code - authorised person, account holder identity

script_or_rule.description: Agent must verify full name as per ID, the email address and the date of birth.
required_phrases: first and last name as per id
email address can you please also verify

checks.name: Card details kept off the recording
checks.regulatory_basis: PCI DSS - no primary account number (PAN) on call recordings

script_or_rule.description: Pass if the agent mentions muting or pausing the recording and no card number (PAN) appears. A PAN on the call fails. Payment discussed with no mute mentioned is unsure.

checks.name: Promotional price and period match the plan
checks.regulatory_basis: TCP Code - price disclosure; ACL misleading representations

script_or_rule.description: The discounted monthly price and how long it lasts, as the agent stated it.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The promotional (discounted) monthly price the AGENT quoted and the number of months it applies for. Assemble spoken number words into digits and answer in the form '<dollars>.<cents> for <n> months'. Use the agent's own statement of the offer, not the customer's.

checks.name: Price after the promotion matches the plan
checks.regulatory_basis: TCP Code - price disclosure

script_or_rule.description: The regular monthly price that applies after the promotion.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The regular / ongoing monthly price the AGENT said applies after the promotional period ends. Assemble spoken number words into digits and answer as '<dollars>.<cents>'.

checks.name: Typical evening (peak) speed matches the plan
checks.regulatory_basis: ACCC broadband speed claims guidance - typical busy-period (7-11pm) speed

script_or_rule.description: Typical download and upload speed in the 7pm-11pm busy period, as the agent stated it.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The typical DOWNLOAD and UPLOAD speeds in Mbps the AGENT stated for the plan (the typical evening / busy-period speed). Assemble spoken number words into digits and answer as '<download>/<upload>'.

checks.name: Modem model and cost match the plan
checks.regulatory_basis: Non-blocking - hardware disclosure

script_or_rule.description: Modem model and its cost to the customer.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The modem model the AGENT said the customer will receive and what it costs the customer. Answer as '<brand> <model>, $<cost>' with spoken number words as digits (for example a model read as 'AB forty' is 'AB40'); 'free' or 'no extra cost' is $0.

checks.name: Total minimum cost disclosed correctly
checks.regulatory_basis: TCP Code - total minimum cost must be disclosed before the sale

script_or_rule.description: The total minimum cost the agent TOLD the customer, as opposed to a figure the agent read off the order screen.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The TOTAL MINIMUM COST that the AGENT asserted to the customer as the cost of the plan. If the agent also read a different total minimum cost off the customer's screen, report the agent's own assertion, not the screen reading. Answer as '<dollars>.<cents>'.

checks.name: New development fee: spoken guarantee vs order screen
checks.regulatory_basis: ACL - no misleading guarantee about charges; TCP Code fee disclosure

script_or_rule.description: What the agent said about the new development fee: the amount, and whether the customer will be charged it.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: What the AGENT said about the NEW DEVELOPMENT FEE: the amount in dollars and whether the customer will be charged it. Answer as '<dollars>; charged' or '<dollars>; not charged'.

reference.label: Lead development fee and order TMC

checks.name: Contract term stated consistently and matches the plan
checks.regulatory_basis: TCP Code - contract term disclosure

script_or_rule.description: The contract term the agent stated. Conflicting statements, or no contract term on the lead, cannot pass.
script_or_rule.extraction_target: The contract term the AGENT stated for the plan, for example 'month to month' or '12 months'. If the agent stated it more than once in different words, report every version separated by ' | '.

checks.name: Talk-over and cut-off turns
checks.regulatory_basis: Coaching only - never blocks a sale

script_or_rule.description: Turns that stop mid-sentence, a sign one party talked over the other. Used because this transcript has no real timings to measure overlap from.

checks.name: Customer confusion
checks.regulatory_basis: Coaching only - never blocks a sale

script_or_rule.description: Customer turns asking the agent to repeat or explain. Coaching signal for pace and clarity.
